name: Butter Bridge retry-message hash collision
summary: Butter Bridge stored failed-message commitments with abi.encodePacked over adjacent dynamic byte fields. The attacker retried a valid failed message with different field boundaries but the same packed preimage, redirecting execution to MAPO and minting one quadrillion unbacked tokens.
notes: The fifth and final pre-exploit Upgraded event selected the implementation executed by the exploit. The EIP-1967 slot and implementation runtime remain unchanged through the pre-exploit block.

The exploit minted 1,000,000,000,000,000 unbacked MAPO, far beyond legitimate supply, so a pre-attack MAPO spot mark is not realizable. Six blocks later the attacker sold exactly 1,000,000,000 MAPO through the Uniswap v4 MAPO/ETH pool and received 52.210047945812131055 ETH. The receipt and trace agree on both quantities. ETH is valued at the DefiLlama observation immediately before the sale. The remaining forged MAPO is excluded because no further realization was identified; the exact onchain proceeds replace the seed row's $180,000 estimate.
